attribution: Ajuntament de Barcelona. Oficina Municipal de Dades (OMD), Barcelona Dades: mean price per m² of dwellings sold (notarial records), registered sales (Generalitat de Catalunya, Secretaria d'Habitatge, from the Col·legi de Registradors) and Idealista asking prices. Third-party series under CC BY-ND 4.0 per the portal's terms; credited, removable on request.
basis: Mean price per m² of dwellings sold in the month (notarial records, OMD Barcelona), city, districts and barris

long_index.basis: Idealista asking price per m² of second-hand dwellings, city of Barcelona, quarter-end months from 2001 (Barcelona Dades); not comparable before 2011

name: Barcelona
notes: Barcelona: the city series is the mean price per m² of the dwellings sold in the month according to the notarial records (Oficina Municipal de Dades), 2012-01 to 2026-10; 10 districts and 71 barris carry the same measure (means of at least 5 sales; small barris are noisy month to month and not mix-adjusted). Under each area: the registered sale price per m² from the land registrars (Generalitat de Catalunya, quarterly from 2014) and, for the city and districts, Idealista's asking price of second-hand dwellings (monthly from 2001). The long-history chart is that asking price for the whole city (quarter-end months); the portal states that asking-price data before 2011 are not comparable with later data (method change).
